title: Remove the modpack
description: Only our files are removed. Other mods stay in place.
removeConfig: Delete the mod settings and the site binding
removeConfigDescription: Deletes the settings in the game folder and their copy in %APPDATA%\TriOtmetki, including the binding key. If another client has the modpack, that copy stays — unbind the device on the site.
confirmTitle: Remove the modpack from this client?
